scope: Semantic review of removing the public /developers surface and all public navigation, search, SEO, and legacy-route pointers to it.
reviewed: Confirmed the /developers and /developers/pricing route modules and route-specific styling are removed; requests are handled by the generic unavailable response rather than exposing implementation details.
Confirmed desktop, mobile, footer, documentation, search, home, pricing, About, metadata, manifest and robots surfaces no longer link to /developers or advertise a public developer landing page.
Confirmed protected preview requests still use the existing authorization boundary and now return a generic private 404 without a redirect or internal diagnostics.

Confirmed legacy public marketing routes that previously converged on /developers now converge on the neutral public landing surface, while private developer APIs and internal authorization modules remain intact.
Confirmed historical incident and audit records retain their original route references as dated evidence rather than being rewritten as current public instructions.

validation.production_build: npm run build passed and generated 164 static pages; the removed developer routes are absent from the route manifest
validation.lint: npm run lint passed with zero errors and eight pre-existing warnings
validation.billing_suite: npm run test:billing:lifecycle passed 18/18 plus webhook boundary checks
validation.migration_inventory: npm run db:verify passed with 145 migrations and paired rollbacks
validation.migration_application: 20260920064323_remove_public_developer_return_path applied; npm run db:status reports 145 applied and zero pending

limits: No live deployment or production acceptance was performed.
